summary:
Implementation plan for strengthening the authentication and password entry system in the language lab app:
- Firebase Email & Password Authentication modal (Sign In / Register / Sign Out)
- Real-time password strength meter (entropy score, character requirements, visual bar)
- Password visibility toggle (Show/Hide password with Eye/EyeOff icons)
- User profile menu in Navbar displaying active authenticated user email or guest status
- Automatic data synchronization with Firestore user profiles
- Fully localized in Kurdish (سۆرانی), Arabic (العربية), and English.
